# Slow Passport

> Personal travel experiences, destination reviews, hiking routes, accommodation notes, and public transport tips based on real journeys.

Personal travel experiences, destination reviews, hiking routes, accommodation notes, and public transport tips based on real journeys.

## About

Slow Passport is a personal travel journal documenting real journeys through
firsthand destination reviews, practical travel experiences, hiking routes,
walking trails, and transportation or accommodation notes. Destinations are
identified in each article; published stories currently include South Korea.

## Topics

- Travel Experiences
- Destination Reviews
- Hiking Trails
- Transportation Tips
- Accommodation Reviews
- Walking Trails

## Published Articles

### Korea Travel

- [Is Mt. Gwanak a Good Mountain to Hike During a Seoul Trip?](https://slowpassport.github.io/posts/korea/gwanak/): A personal hiking guide to Mt. Gwanak from Gwacheon Station, including the route to Yeonjuam Temple, trail tips, and a quiet prayer spot near the summit.
- [Is Mt. Mindungsan Worth Hiking in Jeongseon?](https://slowpassport.github.io/posts/korea/jeongseon-mindoong/): A personal hiking review of Mt. Mindungsan in Jeongseon, including the route from the second parking lot, the steep and slippery descent toward Jeungsan Elementary School, travel tips, reservation notes, and seasonal advice.
- [Is the Geumsan Wellness Walking Challenge a Difficult Hike?](https://slowpassport.github.io/posts/korea/geumsan-wellness-walk/): A personal review of the Geumsan Wellness Walking Challenge, including its uphill section, event experience, reservation notes, accessibility considerations, and a visit to the Seven Hundred Patriotic Martyrs Tomb.
